editionLabel: English summary of Haumea Games French rules (2024)
firstPlayerRule: The most recent player to travel back in time, or to see someone do so, starts. The journey or sighting may be fictional. If nobody qualifies, choose a starting player at random.
clarifications: Beginning with the first player and continuing clockwise, each player chooses a starting Basic Technology card before the first turn.
Multiplayer turns also proceed clockwise from that player; the solo mode uses its own setup.
interpretation: English summary of the French booklet; 'fictivement ou non' expressly allows a fictional example.

internalEvidence: Haumea Games' product page https://www.haumeagames.com/products/eternitium links this official French booklet, matching BGG identity 402324. Its PDF page 4 spans printed pages 6–7 and was rendered and visually checked. The publisher-uploaded English rulebook listed on BGG and independently indexed English text corroborate the same opening instruction, but this record cites the locally inspected French edition. Official French PDF SHA-256: 68cb0fe92f036b071d56d17db5ccfb33df73da683a6521a92efff13a3ef58538. Owner-authorized Codex editorial review, 2026-09-25.
uncertainty: No separate tie rule is given when multiple players claim the same most recent fictional or real event; the random choice is explicitly provided when nobody is designated.
